title: EvoNext
subtitle: Enterprise GRC & BCM Platform
description: A mission-critical enterprise platform used by leading banks for Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC) and Business Continuity Management (BCM). Built frontend modules using React and TypeScript, implemented role-based access flows, audit reporting screens, and improved usability while integrating with a Java backend through REST APIs.

title: Interview Tracker
subtitle: Full-stack SaaS for end-to-end job search tracking
description:
Built a full-stack SaaS style app to manage the complete job search workflow: application tracking, interview rounds, dashboard analytics, and AI-assisted preparation.
Includes JWT auth with HTTP-only cookies, protected CRUD APIs, user-scoped data access, and resume PDF parsing with AI feedback.

AI features include cold email generation, follow-up email generation, interview question generation, and a streaming assistant for interview prep and career guidance.

Live frontend: https://ai-intreview-tracker.vercel.app
Backend API: https://ai-intreview-tracker.onrender.com

Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Zustand, React Hook Form, Zod, Recharts, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT, Multer, pdf-parse, OpenAI, Gemini, SSE

title: Resume Analyzer (RAG)
subtitle: Skill match score + gap analysis
description:
Built a RAG pipeline where users upload a resume and paste a job description to get a skill match score and gap analysis.
Implemented chunking, embeddings, and vector similarity search using Pinecone and LangChain.

Tech: Next.js, Node.js, LangChain, OpenAI API, Pinecone

title: Multi-Tenant Task API
subtitle: Tenant isolation, RBAC & activity logs
description:
Production-grade multi-tenant REST API with organization signup, full tenant isolation, RBAC roles, project and task management, and activity logs.

Tech: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Jest, Supertest

title: AI Developer Assistant
subtitle: AI-powered assistant for coding, debugging, and learning.
description: Built a full-stack developer assistant for practical day-to-day coding help. Generates code, helps debug issues, and explains concepts using OpenAI and Gemini. Key capabilities include multi-mode chat (Code/Debug/Explain/Plan), context-aware replies with sliding window memory, and clean Markdown + code block rendering.

title: Kanban Board
subtitle: Minimalist Task Management App
description: A minimalist bento-style Kanban board built using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Implemented drag-and-drop task flow, simple state management, and a clean grid-based UI focused on clarity, usability, and performance.

title: Edutech Platform
subtitle: Learning Content Platform
description: An educational platform built using React, Node.js, MongoDB and Tailwind CSS where users can create, consume, and rate content. Implemented authentication, OTP-based login, and payment gateway integration for secure access.

title: Caprics Learning
subtitle: Ed-Tech SaaS Platform
description: An education SaaS and admin panel built using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Worked on API integration, admin UI workflows, and optimized backend queries using MongoDB aggregation pipelines for better performance.
